propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as INDETERMINATE on an unrelated ticket whose relation graph walks past the orphan directory.

Event-less directories are created by process death during the write window (makedirs -> stage temp -> atomic rename) and persist invisibly in git, making them undetectable in git status and unrepairable by pull.
The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less directories by skipping them with a warning naming the path, rather than raising reducer-error, allowing reviews of unrelated tickets to proceed.

The writer will continue creating ticket directories before the first event to avoid race-unsafe cleanup under concurrent multi-session writes, and reader-side tolerance alone repairs existing broken clones.
